incidents.name: VTF reward calculation flaw
incidents.notes: VTF's reward accounting credits a holder's share from their instantaneous balance rather than an accrued stake, so the attacker cycled a large borrowed balance through the reward claim and drained the contract's USDT.

sources.ref: onchain review: VTF 0xc6548caF18e20F88cC437a52B6D388b0D54d830D created 2022-10-09T13:43:10Z by 0xf3303397e89d2e7557b02bf7a44f11d0ebf9ceff, unrelated to attack sender 0x57c112cf4f1e4e381158735b12aaf8384b60e1ce; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 59,060.63 USDT left 0x825ef6a0f26a06367d6415fd34f9c9174fdf11e1 and 58,450.66 USDT reached the attacker.
